clue.text: Ten shillings for William or Mary

definitions.meaning: a gold coin worth half of a pound, which was twenty shillings
William III and Mary II reigned jointly, so each was one of two monarchs sharing the throne

explanation.surface: A question of which joint monarch's head appears on a ten-shilling coin.
explanation.definitionFit: The coin worth ten shillings was a half pound piece; and each co-ruler of a joint reign held half the crown.

clue.text: Sprain I remedy with a pain-killer

indicators.note: to remedy something is to put it right, so these letters are fixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone treats a sprained ankle by taking a tablet.
explanation.definitionFit: A common analgesic tablet taken to relieve aches.

clue.text: The exhibition is not too bad

definitions.meaning: a show or fête, such as a trade show or funfair

explanation.surface: A verdict that the show was passable.
explanation.definitionFit: A trade show is called a fair, and a middling result is also described as fair.

clue.text: Work in the theatre

parts.note: reads as acting on stage, but the theatre is a hospital operating theatre where a surgeon works

explanation.surface: An actor gets a job on the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons perform surgery in an operating theatre.

clue.text: Typical measure to exert force on a monarch

parts.note: an em is a printer's unit of measure in typesetting, so 'typical' plays on type
to press is to push with force

explanation.surface: A typical way of putting pressure on a ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Typical' here means relating to printing type, not ordinary; in a down clue the measure sits on top of the force.
explanation.definitionFit: A female sovereign ruling an empire is a monarch.

clue.text: They supply wood to English railway company

parts.note: the LMS was the London, Midland and Scottish Railway, one of Britain's big four railway companies

explanation.surface: A railway company sourcing its timber in England.
explanation.definitionFit: These trees are felled for timber.

clue.text: Plant obtained by fellow Scotsman

parts.note: a gent is a man or chap
Ian is a typically Scottish first name

explanation.surface: A plant acquired by a man from Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: A blue-flowered mountain plant.

clue.text: Dealer has to reject French sea shanty

parts.note: to scrap something is to throw it away
mer is French for sea
a sea shanty is a sailors' work song or chant

explanation.surface: A dealer spurns a French sea song.
explanation.definitionFit: A trader who buys and sells metal waste.

clue.text: Patronising swindler on the downward path

parts.note: a con man or con artist is a swindler; con is short for him
going downhill, moving lower

explanation.surface: A fraudster with a superior air is heading for a fall.
explanation.definitionFit: Treating others with superior, talking-down kindness.

clue.text: Fancy accountant, and the amount he charges

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant
the price is what is charged

explanation.surface: An expensive accountant and his fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A whim or sudden notion is a fancy.

clue.text: Self-righteous people have to get allspice

parts.note: pi is slang for pious, sanctimonious
men are people

explanation.surface: Sanctimonious people must obtain a spice.
explanation.definitionFit: Pimento is another name for allspice, the dried berry of a Caribbean tree.

clue.text: Portion of land for which the Crusaders battled

definitions.meaning: a unit of area of land
the port city in the Holy Land besieged during the Third Crusade

explanation.surface: A patch of ground fought over by medieval knights.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit of land area shares its name with the city of Acre in modern Israel, taken by Richard the Lionheart.

clue.text: Arrived with nothing but a medallion

parts.note: came means arrived
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone turned up with nothing except a medal.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved relief portrait, often set as an oval brooch or medallion.

clue.text: Violet and Edward were in competition

parts.note: Vi is short for the name Violet
Ed is short for Edward

explanation.surface: Two people named Violet and Edward were rivals.
explanation.definitionFit: Competed or strove against one another.

clue.text: Absent-minded quintet gets the shivers

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, and a quintet has five members
ague is a fever with shivering fits

explanation.surface: A distracted group of five musicians catches a chill.
explanation.definitionFit: Vague means dreamy, inattentive.

clue.text: Complain about abdominal pain

explanation.surface: Someone moaning about stomach ache.
explanation.definitionFit: Grumbling and colic share this word: one moans, and a stomach cramp is called gripes.

clue.text: Commission chap to make an appointment

parts.note: a man is a chap
a date is an arranged appointment

explanation.surface: A man is asked to arrange a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: An official authorisation or instruction to act is a commission.

clue.text: Contracts for psychiatrists

definitions.meaning: shrink is slang for a psychiatrist, short for headshrinker

explanation.surface: Agreements drawn up for mental health doctors.
explanation.definitionFit: Becoming smaller is shrinking, and slang calls psychiatrists headshrinkers.

clue.text: Tell tales about a foreign nobleman

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a count is a continental nobleman, equivalent to an earl

explanation.surface: Someone gossips about a European aristocrat.
explanation.definitionFit: To recount is to narrate a story.

clue.text: Ignore lice wandering around the skin

parts.note: to cut someone is to snub or ignore them

indicators.note: the lice roam about, so their letters move into a new order

explanation.surface: Disregarding lice crawling over the skin.
explanation.walkthrough: ICLE is the anagram of LICE.
explanation.definitionFit: The cuticle is the strip of hardened skin at the base of a nail.

clue.text: Reforms are then of central importance in Iran

indicators.note: to reform something is to reshape it, so these letters take a new form

explanation.surface: Political reforms being central to Iran's future.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city, central to the country's government; an older spelling of Tehran.

clue.text: Jaded after one minute as the result of deadlock

indicators.note: the word for jaded is placed following the one and minute pieces

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
passé means stale, outdated

explanation.surface: Weariness setting in after a minute, because talks are stalled.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation where no progress is possible, a stalemate.

clue.text: This month everything is put into place

parts.note: inst., short for instant, means of the current month in old business letters
all is everything

explanation.surface: This month all is set up.
explanation.definitionFit: To install is to set up or fix in position.

clue.text: Help the military

explanation.surface: An appeal to assist the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: Assistance is service, and the forces are known as the services.

clue.text: Martha tended to harbour extremely hostile feelings

indicators.note: to harbour is to shelter within, so the letters sit inside the words

explanation.surface: Martha nursed a grudge.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense dislike or loathing.

clue.text: Has to enter Anglican church to do some engraving

indicators.note: one piece goes into the other, entering it

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Going into a church to make a brass rubbing or carving.
explanation.definitionFit: To chase metal is to engrave or emboss it.

clue.text: Reminder to President and staff

parts.note: a rod is a staff or stick

explanation.surface: A memo sent to the President and staff members.
explanation.definitionFit: A prod is a nudge or reminder to act.

clue.text: Doctor of Engineering is highly regarded in China

explanation.surface: An engineering doctor is respected in China.
explanation.definitionFit: The degree abbreviation matches the surname of the Chinese paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

clue.text: Tax a small, small bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed for a baby

explanation.surface: A levy on a tiny bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Scot is an old word for a tax, as in scot-free.

clue.text: United Nations backs an obvious source of energy

definitions.note: an adjective, as in nuclear power, the energy source

indicators.note: turns back, so the letters of the organisation run in reverse

parts.note: UN is the United Nations
clear means obvious

explanation.surface: The UN supports a clear energy source.
explanation.definitionFit: Atomic power from fission is an energy source.

clue.text: A sale which is very fashionable indeed

definitions.text: A sale which is very fashionable indeed

parts.words: A sale which is very fashionable indeed
parts.note: a sale at a smart saleroom where bidders flock, a sale of the moment

explanation.surface: A very trendy sale.
explanation.definitionFit: A public sale where goods go to the highest bidder, the smart salerooms being places where society gathers.

clue.text: Importunate landlord makes a plea for help

parts.note: begging means pleading, importunate
a letter is one who lets property

explanation.surface: A pushy landlord asks for assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: A written appeal for money or aid.
